scope: Speaker audio in the installed system: kernel r14 + ALSA UCM profile + PipeWire

r14.recipe: fx0-pmaports a993fc0c1 (QCOM_APR, SND_SOC_QCOM, SND_SOC_QDSP6, SND_SOC_MSM8996, SLIMBUS, SLIM_QCOM_NGD_CTRL, SND_SOC_WCD9306 as modules; ASoC compress/topology built in)
r14.ram_boot_first: r14 kernel+DTB booted to a running system with the installed initramfs before installing
r14.installed: boots unattended in 70 s, taint 0, no failed units; NGD comes up without an ADSP restart, codec identifies, card 'LG Fx0' registers, sway starts; rollback copies in local/before-native-r14 and /var/lib/fx0-fallback/before-native-r14

ucm: configs/alsa-ucm2 installed to /usr/share/alsa/ucm2: conf.d/apq8096/LG Fx0.conf -> Qualcomm/msm8926/lg-fx0/HiFi.conf (verb: SLIMBUS_0_RX Audio Mixer MultiMedia1; Speaker device: RX3 MIX1 INP1 RX1, INP2 RX2, SPK DAC Switch)
pipewire: WirePlumber exposes 'Built-in Audio Speaker playback' (alsa_output.platform-sound.HiFi__Speaker__sink, S24_LE 2ch 48 kHz) as the default sink; UCM controls applied; codec ports consumed
listening: owner: silent at the default 40% sink volume (about -48 dB with the codec's stock -24 dB); both tones clean at 100% via pw-play
open: volume range: expose a limited hardware volume or raise the codec gain so the default level is audible
'QMI wait timeout' logged once after the NGD registers (second bring-up attempt; harmless so far)
device package should ship the UCM files
